name: Build a Wind-Down Routine
equipment: A dim lamp and a comfortable spot away from your bed
instructions: Start winding down 30-45 minutes before bed with the same short sequence every night -- your brain learns to associate it with sleep.
Dim overhead lights and switch to a lamp; bright light in the evening delays your body's natural melatonin release.
Put your phone in another room or on do-not-disturb -- even silent notifications interrupt the wind-down signal.
Follow tonight's guided deep sleep meditation as the last step of the routine, right before lights out.
